Prerequisite: Must have Insectoid Armor

Through research and creativity, you have created a Perfect Sphere with no contact area which generates infinite pressure. As an action for 10 Cursed Energy, you create a 10-foot diameter perfect sphere of metal that appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within 10 feet of you and lasts for 1 minute while concentrating. Any creature that touches or ends its turn within 5 feet of the sphere must make a Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes 8d12 force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

As a bonus action, you can move the sphere up to 30 feet. If you ram the sphere into a creature, that creature must make the saving throw against the sphere’s damage, and the sphere stops moving this turn.
When you move the sphere, it destroys all barriers and non-magical structures in its way.
